detail.longDescription:
I wrote about this some time ago, but I know things are constantly changing in the world of technology, so perhaps, someone has created something usable for us.  I am seeking a program or website similar to Omni Describer, which uses artificial intelligence to generate audio descriptions of videos.  I am an individual doing this for myself.  I used Omni Describer when it was free and loved it, but I can't justify their current prices for home use.  At any rate, the site/program must have the following features.
1.  Must be either free or affordable (no more than $25 per month).
2.  Must be able to handle videos of at least an hour in length.
3.  Must be fully accessible with NVDA.
4.  Must allow me to download the audio of the video with descriptions in mp3 (preferred) or the video itself with descriptions.
Does such a program or site exist or is there a way to bring various technologies together to create it?  For those who are against such things, I am one individual doing this for myself, not for an educational setting, a government organisation, or the general public.  I can't afford to hire people to describe cat videos, tell me what a basket weaver is doing when she says "put this reed here like that", describe all of the nature videos I watch, etc.  I'm not seeking perfection or professional quality, just an idea of what is going on.

#accessibility #AI #ai #ArtificialIntelligence #AudioDescription #blind #NVDA #technology #videos #Windows #Windows7
